item.title: HS ROUNDUP: Dallas boys finish regular season undefeated
item.description: Pat Flanagan scored 14 points and Kael Berry finished with 13 to lead Dallas to a 47-38 win over Crestwood on Thursday night in a Wyoming Valley Conference Division 1 boys basketball game at Dallas. The Division 1 champion Mountaineers close the regular season with a 12-0 record. They will head to the WVC tournament to take on the No. 2 seed from Division 2 on Thursday at Wilkes-Barre Area at a time to be announced. item.title: Community Spotlight: Mountain Top – Feb. 6, 2026
item.description: Nuangola Library book fair: 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. Saturday, Feb. 7. Barnes & Noble, Arena Hub Plaza, Wilkes-Barre Twp. Customers will be offered a voucher that they present to the cashier upon their purchase. There is no additional cost to the customer. The library will receive a percentage of the store’s profits for that day’s sales. All money raised goes to the library’s scholarship fund for graduating Crestwood seniors.
